articles.title_en: On Groves mechanisms for costly inclusion
articles.title_cn: 论代价高昂的纳入的Groves机制
authors: Mackenzie, Andrew (Department of Microeconomics and Public Economics, Maastricht University)
Trudeau, Christian (Department of Economics, University of Windsor)
Andrew Mackenzie
Christian Trudeau
articles.abstract_en: We investigate Groves mechanisms for economies where (i) a social outcome specifies a group of winning agents, and (ii) a cost function associates each group with a monetary cost. In particular, we characterize both (i) the class of cost functions for which there are Groves mechanisms such that the agents cover the costs through voluntary payments, and (ii) the class of cost functions for which there are envy-free Groves mechanisms. It follows directly from our results that whenever production efficient and envy-free allocations can be implemented in dominant strategies, this can moreover be done while funding production through voluntary payments.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究社会结果指定一组获胜代理人且成本函数将每组与一个货币成本相联系的经济体中的Groves机制。特别地，我们刻画了(i)存在Groves机制使得代理人通过自愿支付覆盖成本的成本函数类，以及(ii)存在无嫉妒Groves机制的成本函数类。从我们的结果可直接得出，只要生产有效且无嫉妒的配置能在占优策略中实施，这还可以在通过自愿支付为生产融资的同时实现。

authors: Denti, Tommaso (Department of Economics, Cornell University)
articles.abstract_en: In many strategic environments, information acquisition is a central component of the game that is played. Being uncertain about a payoff-relevant state, a player in a game has a two-fold incentive to acquire information: learning the state and learning what others know. We develop a model of information acquisition in games that accounts for players' incentive to learn what others know. In applications to rational inattention and global games, we prove the power of this incentive. When information acquisition is ``independent''---that is, players can acquire information only about the state---severe coordination problems emerge among rationally inattentive players. When information acquisition is ``unrestricted''---that is, players can acquire information about the state and each other's information in a flexible way---we show that rational inattention admits a sharp logit characterization, and we provide a new rationale. for selecting risk dominant equilibria in coordination games.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多策略环境中，信息获取是所进行博弈的核心组成部分。由于对与收益相关的状态不确定，博弈中的参与者有双重动机去获取信息：了解状态和了解他人所知。我们建立了一个博弈中信息获取的模型，该模型考虑了参与者了解他人所知的动机。在理性疏忽和全局博弈的应用中，我们证明了这种动机的力量。当信息获取是“独立的”——即参与者只能获取关于状态的信息——时，理性疏忽的参与者之间会出现严重的协调问题。当信息获取是“无限制的”——即参与者可以以灵活的方式获取关于状态和彼此信息的信息——时，我们表明理性疏忽允许一个清晰的logit刻画，并且我们为在协调博弈中选择风险占优均衡提供了一个新的理由。

authors: Iaryczower, Matias (Department of Politics, Princeton University)
Oliveros, Santiago (Department of Economics, University of Bristol)
Santiago Oliveros
articles.abstract_en: We consider dynamic processes of coalition formation in which a principal bargains sequentially with a group of agents. This problem is at the core of a variety of applications in economics, including lobbying, exclusive deals, and acquisition of complementary patents. In this context, we study how the allocation of bargaining power between principal and agents affects efficiency and welfare. We show that when the principal's willingness to pay is large relative to agents' payoffs for completion, efficiency requires concentrating bargaining power in the principal. Strengthening the bargaining position of the agents increases inefficient delay and reduces agents' welfare. This occurs in spite of the lack of informational asymmetries or discriminatory offers. When this collective action problem is severe enough, agents are better off when bargaining power is concentrated in the principal.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑联盟形成的动态过程，其中委托人与一群代理人进行序贯谈判。该问题是经济学中多种应用的核心，包括游说、排他性交易以及互补专利的收购。在此背景下，我们研究委托人与代理人之间谈判力的分配如何影响效率与福利。我们表明，当委托人的支付意愿相对于代理人完成交易的收益较大时，效率要求将谈判力集中于委托人。增强代理人的谈判地位会增加无效率的延迟并降低代理人的福利。尽管不存在信息不对称或歧视性报价，这种情况仍会发生。当这一集体行动问题足够严重时，谈判力集中于委托人会使代理人状况更好。

authors: Kirpalani, Rishabh (Department of Economics, University of Wisconsin-Madison)
Madsen, Erik (Department of Economics, New York University)
articles.abstract_en: We study the interaction of incentives to free-ride on information acquisition and strategically delay irreversible investment in environments in which multiple firms evaluate an investment opportunity. In our model, two firms decide how quickly to privately obtain information about the profitability of a project, and when (if ever) to publicly invest in it. Multiple equilibria exist, differing with respect to how much information firms acquire as well as how quickly they invest. The equilibrium which maximizes aggregate payoffs features asymmetric play with distinct leader and follower roles when firms are patient, but features symmetric play when firms are impatient and information acquisition costs are sufficiently high.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在多个企业评估一项投资机会的环境中，搭便车获取信息的激励与战略性延迟不可逆投资之间的相互作用。在我们的模型中，两家企业决定以多快速度私下获取关于项目盈利性的信息，以及何时（如果会的话）公开投资于该项目。存在多重均衡，它们在企业在信息获取量以及投资速度方面有所不同。当企业有耐心时，最大化总收益的均衡具有不对称的博弈特征，存在明确的领导者和追随者角色；但当企业缺乏耐心且信息获取成本足够高时，该均衡具有对称的博弈特征。

articles.title_cn: 与不断演变的私人信息讨价还价
authors: Ortner, Juan (Department of Economics, Boston University)
Juan Matias Ortner
articles.abstract_en: I study how the arrival of new private information affects bargaining outcomes. A seller makes offers to a buyer. The buyer is privately informed about her valuation, and the seller privately observes her stochastically changing cost of delivering the good. Prices fall gradually at the early stages of negotiations, and trade is inefficiently delayed. The first-best is implementable via a mechanism, whereas all equilibrium outcomes of the bargaining game are inefficient.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究新的私人信息的到来如何影响讨价还价结果。一个卖方对买方提出报价。买方私下知道自己的估值，而卖方私下观察到她随机变化的交货成本。价格在谈判初期逐渐下降，交易被无效率地延迟。第一最优可以通过一种机制实现，而讨价还价博弈的所有均衡结果都是无效率的。

articles.title_en: Optimal allocations with α-MaxMin utilities, Choquet expected utilities, and Prospect Theory
articles.title_cn: α-MaxMin效用、Choquet期望效用和前景理论下的最优分配
authors: Beissner, Patrick (Research School of Economics, ANU)
Werner, Jan (Department of Economics, University of Minnesota)
Jan Werner
articles.abstract_en: The analysis of optimal risk sharing has been thus far largely restricted to non-expected utility models with concave utility functions, where concavity is an expression of ambiguity aversion and/or risk aversion. This paper extends the analysis to α-maxmin expected utility, Choquet expected utility, and Cumulative Prospect Theory, which accommodate ambiguity seeking and risk seeking attitudes. We introduce a novel methodology of quasidifferential calculus of Demyanov and Rubinov (1986, 1992) and argue that it is particularly well-suited for the analysis of these three classes of utility functions which are neither concave nor differentiable. We provide characterizations of quasidifferentials of these utility functions, derive first-order conditions for Pareto optimal allocations under uncertainty, and analyze implications of these conditions for risk sharing with and without aggregate risk.
articles.abstract_cn: 迄今为止，最优风险分担的分析在很大程度上局限于具有凹效用函数的非期望效用模型，其中凹性表示模糊厌恶和/或风险厌恶。本文将分析扩展到α-maxmin期望效用、Choquet期望效用和累积前景理论，这些理论容纳了模糊寻求和风险寻求态度。我们引入了Demyanov和Rubinov（1986，1992）的拟微分计算这一新颖方法，并认为它特别适合分析这三类既非凹也非可微的效用函数。我们提供了这些效用函数的拟微分的特征，推导了不确定性下帕累托最优分配的一阶条件，并分析了这些条件对有无总风险的风险分担的含义。

articles.title_en: Incentives in matching markets: counting and comparing manipulating agents
articles.title_cn: 匹配市场中的激励：计数与比较操纵代理人
authors: Bonkoungou, Somouaoga (Faculty of Business and Economics, University of Lausanne, Internef, CH-1015 Lausanne, Switzerland)
Nesterov, Alexander (Department of Economics and Game Theory Lab, Higher School of Economics, 16, Soyuza Pechatnikov st., 190121, St. Petersburg, Russia)
Alexander Nesterov
articles.abstract_en: Manipulability is a threat to the successful design of centralized matching markets. However, in many applications some manipulation is inevitable and the designer wants to compare manipulable mechanisms. We count the number of agents with an incentive to manipulate and rank mechanisms by their level of manipulability. This ranking sheds a new light on practical design decisions such as the design of the entry-level medical labor market in the US, and school admissions systems in New York, Chicago, Denver and many cities in Ghana and in the UK.
articles.abstract_cn: 可操纵性对集中匹配市场的成功设计构成威胁。然而，在许多应用中，某些操纵不可避免，设计者希望比较可操纵的机制。我们计数有激励进行操纵的代理人数量，并根据其可操纵程度对机制进行排序。这一排序为实际设计决策提供了新的视角，例如美国入门级医疗劳动力市场的设计，以及纽约、芝加哥、丹佛和加纳及英国许多城市的学校招生系统。

articles.title_en: All sequential allotment rules are obviously strategy-proof
articles.title_cn: 所有序贯分配规则都是显然策略防的
authors: Arribillaga, R. Pablo (Instituto de Matemática Aplicada San Luis, Universidad Nacional de San Luis and CONICET)
Massó, Jordi (Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona and Barcelona School of Economics)
Neme, Alejandro (Instituto de Matemática Aplicada San Luis)
R. Pablo Arribillaga
Jordi Masso
articles.abstract_en: For division problems with single-peaked preferences, we show that all sequential allotment rules, a large subfamily of strategy-proof and efficient rules, are also obviously strategy-proof. Although obvious strategy-proofness is in general more restrictive than strategy-proofness, this is not the case in this setting.
articles.abstract_cn: 对于具有单峰偏好的分配问题，我们证明所有序贯分配规则，即策略防且有效规则的一个大子族，也是显然策略防的。尽管显然策略防性通常比策略防性更具限制性，但在该设定下并非如此。

articles.title_en: Optimal disclosure of information to privately informed agents
articles.title_cn: 向私人知情代理人最优披露信息
authors: Candogan, Ozan (Booth School of Business, University of Chicago)
Strack, Philipp (Department of Economics, Yale University)
articles.abstract_en: We study information design with multiple privately informed agents who interact in a game. Each agent's utility is linear in a real-valued state. We show that there always exists an optimal mechanism which is laminar partitional and bound its ``complexity''. For each type profile, such a mechanism partitions the state space and recommends the same action profile within a partition element. Furthermore, the convex hulls of any two partition elements are such that either one contains the other or they have an empty intersection. We highlight the value of screening: the ratio of the optimal and the best payoff without screening can be equal to the number of types. Along the way, we shed light on the solutions to optimization problems over distributions subject to a mean-preserving contraction constraint and additional side constraints, which might be of independent interest.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究多个私人知情代理人在博弈中互动时的信息设计。每个代理人的效用与一个实值状态呈线性关系。我们证明，总存在一个最优机制，它是层状划分的，并对其“复杂度”进行了界定。对于每个类型剖面，这样的机制划分状态空间，并在一个划分元素内推荐相同的行动剖面。此外，任意两个划分元素的凸包要么一个包含另一个，要么它们的交集为空。我们强调筛选的价值：最优收益与无筛选时最佳收益之比可以等于类型数量。在此过程中，我们阐明了对受均值保持收缩约束和额外侧面约束的分布进行优化问题的解，这可能具有独立意义。

articles.title_cn: 时间一致性的公平社会选择
authors: Miyagishima, Kaname (Department of Economics, Aoyama Gakuin University)
Kaname Miyagishima
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we study intertemporal social welfare evaluations when agents have heterogeneous time preferences that are interpersonally noncomparable. We first show that, even if all agents share the same time preferences, there is a conflict between the axioms of Pareto principle, time consistency, and equity requiring society to reduce inequality regardless of the past. We argue that responsibility for past choices should be taken into account and thus the equity axiom is not compelling. Then, we introduce another form of equity that takes the past into consideration and is compatible with time consistency. Using this form of equity and time consistency, we characterize maximin and leximin social welfare criteria that are history-dependent.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究当代理人具有异质性时间偏好且这些偏好不可进行人际比较时的跨期社会福利评价。我们首先表明，即使所有代理人都具有相同的时间偏好，帕累托原则、时间一致性和要求社会无论过去如何都应减少不平等的公平性公理之间也存在冲突。我们认为，应当考虑对过去选择的责任，因此公平性公理并不具有说服力。然后，我们引入另一种考虑过去且与时间一致性相容的公平性形式。利用这种公平性形式和时间一致性，我们刻画了依赖于历史的极大极小和词典极小社会福利标准。

authors: Kikuchi, Kazuya (World Language and Society Education Center, Tokyo University of Foreign Studies)
Koriyama, Yukio (Department of Economics, CREST, Ecole Polytechnique, Institut Polytechnique de Paris)
Yukio Koriyama
articles.abstract_en: We consider collective decision making when society consists of groups endowed with voting weights. Each group chooses an internal rule that specifies the allocation of its weight to alternatives as a function of its members' preferences. Under fairly general conditions, we show that the winner-take-all rule is a dominant strategy, while the equilibrium is Pareto dominated, highlighting the dilemma structure between optimality for each group and for the whole society. We also develop a technique for asymptotic analysis and show Pareto dominance of the proportional rule.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑当社会由拥有投票权重的群体组成时的集体决策。每个群体选择一种内部规则，该规则根据其成员的偏好来指定其权重在备选方案之间的分配。在相当一般的条件下，我们表明赢者通吃规则是一种占优策略，而均衡是帕累托被支配的，这凸显了每个群体最优与整个社会最优之间的困境结构。我们还发展了一种渐近分析技术，并证明了比例规则的帕累托支配性。

articles.title_cn: 哪些误设定会持续存在？
authors: Fudenberg, Drew (Department of Economics, Massachusetts Institute of Technology)
Lanzani, Giacomo (Department of Economics, Massachusettes Institute of Technology)
Drew Fudenberg
articles.abstract_en: We use an evolutionary model to determine which misperceptions can persist. Every period, a new generation of agents use their subjective models and the data generated by the previous generation to update their beliefs, and models that induce better actions become more prevalent. An equilibrium can resist mutations that lead agents to use a model that better fits the equilibrium data but induce the mutated agents to take an action with lower payoffs. We characterize which steady states resist mutations to a nearby model, and which resist mutations that drop a qualitative restriction such as independence.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用一个演化模型来确定哪些错误感知能够持续存在。每一期，新一代代理人使用其主观模型以及上一代生成的数据来更新其信念，而诱导更好行动的模型会变得更加普遍。一个均衡能够抵御这样的突变：使代理人使用一个更拟合均衡数据的模型，但诱导突变代理人采取收益更低的行动。我们刻画了哪些稳态能够抵御向邻近模型的突变，以及哪些稳态能够抵御放弃诸如独立性这类定性限制的突变。
